Definition: from G5062 and G2094; of forty years of age:--(+ full, of) forty years (old).
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses tessarakontaetḗs where it means forty years old. In Acts 7:23, he was full forty years old, and it appears again in Acts 13:18. In the Greek text the word is spelled τεσσερακονταετής.
TheologicalSignificance: Moses turning forty and stepping out to help his people tells me God can use a midlife decision to start a calling.
